items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, requeues, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is provider-aggregate and not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost, including 225 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are unknown because periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning threshold is defined. Pilot output of 70 treatment items versus 44 controls is operational activity, not financial or causal lift. Continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation work item using recorded telemetry.

Keep financial containment in place. Minimum evidence before reconsidering growth is period-aligned revenue attributable by site, content, and tracking ID; a reconciled AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment cost ledger; approved budget ceilings; and a defined learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn. No new telemetry, spending, banking, billing, contracts, or external commitments are requested.
